scientific_question: Does the original PD15 norm-to-observation alignment cause full clustered-16D component recovery, when a permutation placebo retains the exact same norm-derived weight multiset, marginal weight distribution and effective sample size while destroying its correlation with that observation's latent support count?

source.generator: EXACT PD12 source generator and PD15 source_for_seed and physical BPD evaluator, unchanged; source seeds new
source.training_pool: One 2048-board four-pass source pool and original PD12 QR initial basis shared by all learned arms of each registered seed
source.independent_unit: seed and seeded hidden 16D rotation Q

objective.gaussian_mass: exact PD15 exp(-.5*(xV/sigma)^2), fixed original source sigma
objective.weight_formula: exp(-sum(x_j^2)) on observed physical vectors only
objective.shuffled_weights: torch.randperm(N, generator=manual_seed(910000+source_seed)) over all 8192 pass vectors, applied to the exact aligned weight vector
objective.shuffled_control_ESS: exact same weights in a different order, thus exact same sum(w), sum(w²), ESS, histogram and floating-point near-equality
objective.shuffled_control_independence: single predeclared RNG permutation, no selection based on latent support/cardinality/Q/heldout outcomes
objective.uniform_control: ones weights and original PD15 unweighted optimizer
objective.pair_order: original PD12 lexicographic i<j all 120 pairs per sweep
objective.RNG_independence: The permutation depends only on seed and N, never source sample labels or future outcomes

scoring.diagnostic_gate: at least 30/32 source pools have Pearson corr(aligned_w,k)<=-0.70, abs(corr(shuffled_w,k))<=0.05 and equal aligned/shuffled ESS within 1e-10
scoring.secondary: uniform_control vs each weighted arm, per-seed full mask, MSE, read cosines, final training objective, and runtime descriptive without additional registered significance claim
